weight: light
tier: 1
charter: C8

specs/factory-step3-v1/SPEC.md row TB8. adlc lets a child complete while its parent is open, and GitHub orders nothing by label, so the hold and the tier order live in CI.

Closes the pre-spec simulation gaps merge:G3, merge:G5, ci:G9, ci:G10, intake:I3, intake:I4, node:G8 (ids are `<segment>:<id>` rows of specs/factory-step3-v1/records/sim/<segment>.md, re-checked in specs/factory-step3-v1/records/TB0.md).

Deliverables:
- `factory/bin/depends-check.sh` and a required `depends-on` job on pull_request and the queue path: the parents are the tickets in the base store with an edge to this ticket; pass only if every parent is completed in the base store; never read the PR body.
- A `tier-order` job: a tier-n ticket PR waits (exit 1 with the blocking PR numbers) while any approved, green, open ticket PR of a lower tier exists; first-done-first within a tier by the PR's first green `gates` time.
- A trusted labeler (a workflow on push to main and on schedule, never pull_request_target running head code) applies `tier:<n>` to open ticket PRs from the base store and writes the PR body's display lines (`Depends-on:`, tier, prosecuting adapter, `Assisted-by`). GITHUB_TOKEN events start no other workflow (GitHub docs, quoted in specs/factory-step3-v1/records/TB0.md), so re-evaluation of held PRs runs on push to main and on a schedule, with the App token when it exists.

Acceptance criteria:
1. A child before its parent is held, and released after the parent completes. Verify: `bash tests/test_depends_check.sh`.
2. A tier-1 PR waits for a tier-0 one; ties break by first green. Verify: `bash tests/test_tier_order.sh`.
3. The labeler applies tier labels and display lines from the base store only. Verify: `bash tests/test_labeler.sh`.
4. The child-before-parent and tier-jump scenarios are green. Verify: `make sim`.
5. Every new or changed script is shellcheck -S warning clean and every workflow passes actionlint. Verify: `make lint`.
6. The whole offline suite passes, including the simulation. Verify: `make test` and `make sim`.

New paths (created by this ticket, so they match nothing yet): `factory/bin/depends-check.sh`, `factory/bin/tier-order.sh`, `factory/bin/labeler.sh`, `.github/workflows/labeler.yml`, `tests/test_depends_check.sh`, `tests/test_tier_order.sh`, `tests/test_labeler.sh`.

Out of scope: any write to GitHub (no push, PR, label, ruleset or secret; I1); editing anything under factory/policy/ (I15: a change there is a desk note in the spec's HANDOFF); editing other tickets.
title: Add the Depends-on hold and tier order as required CI jobs, with a trusted labeler
